listing.name: Metropolismania — Metropolismania PC (koaque)
listing.summary: The project reports booting and reaching the city, but the game is not ready for a playthrough. Setup uses Ghidra and a local build. Its 71% function-rewrite claim does not measure working gameplay. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-20377 version VER1.02 disc as BIN/CUE or ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the documented Windows source build using Ghidra, JDK, the toolchain, extraction and static recompilation. These instructions do not establish a ready-to-run release.

warnings: The project reports booting and reaching the city, but the game is not ready for a playthrough. Setup uses Ghidra and a local build. Its 71% function-rewrite claim does not measure working gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
